task: Run `go test ./...` in a Go module that uses `vendor/` (go mod vendor). The test binary must resolve dependencies from the vendor directory, not the module cache. Report whether all tests pass or fail, identify any flake patterns across 3 runs with -count=1, and confirm the race detector was used.
expected_outcomes: Runs tests with -mod=vendor and -count=1 to bypass build cache
Runs with -race flag for concurrency detection
Categorizes failures as: real failure / flake / pre-existing / environment
Reports overall pass/fail exit code and which packages failed
Does not modify any source files
